title: French Grilled Corn with Elote Butter
description: A simple and flavorful French-inspired grilled corn with a creamy elote butter.

ingredients.name: brine
ingredients.notes: kosher salt, dissolved in 1 cup of water

instructions: 2. Soak the corn in the brine solution for at least 30 minutes.
3. Remove the corn from the brine and shake off excess liquid.
4. Grill the corn for 10-12 minutes, turning frequently.
5. Meanwhile, mix the softened elote butter with chili powder and paprika.
6. Brush the elote butter mixture onto the grilled corn during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
7. Serve the grilled corn hot with additional elote butter on the side.
